inputs.title: Little Dumbbell Nebula (M76)
inputs.acquisition: The publisher's JPEG (4000 x 2524 px) with its stars removed by `node labs/nebula/run.mts remove-stars src/objects/m76-layers --coarse=4` (NOX over the whole picture). NOX then ran again over a copy a quarter of the size (1000 x 631 px), where the saturated stars are small enough for it, and the picture took that pass's result where it took a star: 2.71% of the picture. Restored from the source cache; not tracked. Its place on the sky is the file's embedded tags (recipe observation). A display composite, not a calibrated scientific array.
